explanation: Pteranodon was a flying reptile and Plesiosaurus a sea reptile. Sail-backed Dimetrodon lived long before the dinosaurs and was closer kin to mammals.

claims.text: Pteranodon, Plesiosaurus and Dimetrodon were not dinosaurs.
Pteranodon was a pterosaur, a flying reptile, and Plesiosaurus was a marine reptile.
Dimetrodon was a synapsid, more closely related to mammals than to dinosaurs.
